52:18.text: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

52:21.text: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.
Every person, for what he earned, is retained.

52:22.text: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
